source: NOT a GLB: the low-hover-drone has no skeleton and no model file (assetRef procedural.drone). Its body is the box BoxGeometry(0.56, 0.24, 0.38) in Armagedom Web/src/low-hover-drone.js (watcher appearance), centred on the model root, drawn at DRONE_VISUAL_SCALE 2. These two points are the ends of that box along its long axis (x), at the model-root height the game hovers at: hoverHeight 0.9 m (Web/src/data/creatures.json) / scale 2 = 0.45 model units. They are the two ends of the one capsule, not joints.
units: model units (metres before the game's model scale 2)

bbox_model_units.source: the body box only; the four rotor rings (about 0.9 model units across with the arms) and the sensor pod under the nose (down to y -0.21) are outside it
